title: Creative mode: what it does when it gets stuck
blurb: When the model is stuck on a question, it tries many ideas and checks each one against the examples. This part says how that works, what an earlier test found, and what is still only planned as of Oct 11.

scenes.heading: Stuck on a puzzle? You try ideas

caption.text: Picture yourself stuck on a puzzle. What do you do?
You try an idea, check it, and try another one.
Our model can do the same, but only when it is stuck.

src: creative-roadmap/creative-roadmap-2026-10-06.md line 107 (Settled, Ben 10-05: creativity is only for when the model runs into trouble on a task)

scenes.heading: How it notices it is stuck

caption.text: First the model makes one careful best-guess try, with creative mode switched off.
Then it checks that try on the question's own examples.
If the try does not fit the examples, the model counts itself stuck.

scenes.heading: Stuck first: lots of tries

caption.text: Only then does it try lots of ideas: 32 sampled tries.
If none of the 32 fits, it gets 480 more, so 512 in all.
A question it already solved gets no extra tries.

scenes.heading: The example checker keeps what fits

caption.text: A checker runs every try on the examples that came with the question. It needs no answer key.
A try that fits every example is kept. The rest are thrown away.
For each question it keeps at most 2 different fitting tries.

scenes.heading: The earlier test, and a near miss

caption.text: We tried it on an older small design, on two trial copies, with development questions.
The search worked: it found 180 and 237 checked tries on multi-step questions. The bars were 75 and 90.
After two nights, first-try scores on multi-step questions rose 10.4 and 9.7 points. The bar was 10.
Copy B gained 15 of 154 questions where 16 were needed. Not a pass, and not proved wrong.

scenes.heading: At night it practises what it found

caption.text: At night it practises on its own checked tries. That is the sleep from Part 9.
Two nights, with a day of search between them.
On two copies, harm to old skills was -1.1 and -1.5 points. Below zero means no forgetting.
Multi-step first tries matched the standard nights: -1.9 and +1.9 points. A check on six copies has not been run.

scenes.heading: Where it stands as of Oct 11

caption.text: As of Oct 11, creative mode is planned for the first big run, in a day-and-night phase after the main training.
It has four parts: the stuck test, the stuck-first search, the example checker, and the nights.
Dropped from that run: the small creative add-on, because it did not survive the nights.
Sealed tests at 3M and 10M are planned, not yet run. So far it passed only on older small designs.
